before: An empty w:hideMark cell kept one line of the paragraph mark, so a row of empty hidden-mark cells took a full line.
after: The empty final paragraph of a w:hideMark cell takes no height, also in an otherwise empty cell; cell margins, w:trHeight, paragraph borders, list markers and markup-view mark revisions still reserve space.
reason: Only row height at layout time changes. Shared nodes, operation shapes, offsets, and package serialization remain unchanged, and the collapsed paragraph keeps its addressable line.
